thesis: Power Artifact reduces an artifact’s activated costs by two mana, a modest-looking discount that becomes infinite mana when attached to the right monolith.

claims.summary: The Aura reduces the generic portion of the enchanted artifact's activated-ability costs by {2}, not below one mana when a mana payment is present. It does not discount casting costs, colored mana, tap costs or mana abilities that already cost zero. Tap Basalt Monolith for {C}{C}{C}; with Power Artifact attached, pay one generic to untap it, retaining two floating. Repeating can build arbitrarily large colorless mana. A payoff such as Stroke of Genius still needs its colored blue requirement, and destroying the Aura or artifact during a priority window ends the loop.

Wizards of the Coast documented Power Artifact + Grim Monolith as an infinite-mana combo in its 2003 Top 50 Blue Cards retrospective, and described removing Basalt Monolith's self-untap restriction in 2006. The added 60-card deck is a curated period-plausible rules study, not any player registration or tournament result.
